faqs.a:
All licenses granted pursuant to this article shall be for a term of one year. Said
               term shall commence on January 1 of each year and terminate upon December 31 of the
               same year. Applications for a license filed at any other time during the year shall
               be treated the same as if they were filed January 1 of that year and shall terminate
               on December 31 of that year, and no proration shall be permitted.
(Code 1981, § 6-101; Ord. No. 3496, § 2, 12-14-1998; Ord. No. 3606, § 1, 4-3-2000)
